csharp.detail: all SnapshotWireTests, each [Property("carried","test/plan/snapshot")]; Generator 188, Types 852, Data 849, Modules 1284, Runtime 1043, Wire 534, all other suites green

plang.result: modal baseline reproduced, non-deterministic by the llm family
plang.note: run 2's extra fail was LlmCache (live OpenAI call, transient 'network unreachable')

findings.title: LlmCache is a live-network flake with a weak assertion
findings.step_says: titled 'Cache hit — verify second returns cached result'
findings.pr_or_code_does: asserts only %first%/%second% is not null; never that %second% was served from cache; first call hits api.openai.com so it reds offline (1 of 3 runs)
findings.status_routed: builder (assert a cache hit, red when cache off); live-OpenAI carried to next branch
findings.recommendation: skip-guard when no key/network (mirror the Landlock skip); assert %second% equals %first% or a cache-hit signal

findings.title: GoalCallReturn is a false-green on the return value it names
findings.step_says: 'goal call with return value' — call ComputeAnswer (returns 42), write to %answer%
findings.pr_or_code_does: assert %answer% is not null — never checks the value is 42, so any non-null return passes

findings.title: task plan's plang rewrite is incomplete (C# backstops it)
findings.step_says: indexes ~29 behaviours; Stage3 foreach-parallel (6), Stage4 builder goldens (5), Stage2 task/list (3) each name a plang test
findings.pr_or_code_does: ~14 of those .test.goal files do not exist; the task module core is tested+green and all missing behaviours are covered by PLang.Tests/Runtime/App/Goals/TaskTests.cs (39 tests); task/list is next-branch (723)
findings.recommendation: finish the plang rewrite on the next branch; the plan index currently reads as if the tests exist

findings.title: list-query plan index points to a stale test name
findings.pr_or_code_does: the file is WhereUnsetVariableIsNotFound.test.goal (exists, passes); the indexed name would not resolve if the index chain ran
findings.recommendation: rename the index reference to WhereUnsetVariableIsNotFound

findings.title: the run's coverage report under-credits
findings.step_says: coverage block reports 94/142 and marks on.cache and on.timeout uncovered
findings.pr_or_code_does: both appear in built, passing test .pr (timeoutproducescancellation builds on.timeout(After='100ms'); ClausesCompose builds on.cache)
findings.recommendation: do not take 94/142 at face value; the report misses actions used as clauses

findings.title: genuine plang coverage gaps
findings.pr_or_code_does: no plang test; http.request/timer.sleep/variable.set+clear+remove are tested; variable.get/exists likely C#-backstopped (VariablesTests.cs, VariableCodeTests.cs)
findings.recommendation: add plang tests on the next branch; excludes next-branch-owned and os/ui/builder-internal actions

findings.title: weak-only passing tests (strengthen or accept)
findings.pr_or_code_does: only assert isNotNull/isNotEmpty; StepResult's %!data% is 'hello' but unchecked; the others are production smoke tests
findings.recommendation: StepResult could assert equals 'hello'; the rest are defensible

part5_csharp_quality.conclusion: added C# tests predominantly drive real actions/types and assert observable outcomes; one enum-membership shape-pin

summary: No merge blocker. Baseline is honest and git-clean; C# green but for 6 carried snapshot. All findings are test-quality (carry): two clear false-greens on named value/cache contracts (T5, T1), an incomplete plang rewrite with C# backstop (T2), a stale index name (T3), a coverage report that under-credits (T4a) and a handful of real plang coverage gaps (T4b).
